acceptanceCriteria: The refusal names the limit, its configured value and the observed value.
A focused cmd/corvint test asserts the fields.
body: Residual from lane bf-1022q (PR beamfall/corvint#1547, seal 52f25c48d). corvint docs maintain refuses with documentation-limit-exceeded but does not say which limit, its value, or the observed size, so the operator cannot act.
title: docs maintain reports documentation-limit-exceeded without naming the limit
